questions.q: AIRSPEED_MIN = 13, Q_ASSIST_SPEED = 18. At what airspeed does the forward transition leave AIRSPEED_WAIT?
options: 13 m/s
Above 18 m/s
After Q_TRANSITION_MS, whatever the airspeed
questions.explain: The condition is aspeed > AIRSPEED_MIN with no assistance; while the airspeed is below Q_ASSIST_SPEED, assistance is active. In SITL: "Transition airspeed reached 18.3".

options: The transition timeout: if the airspeed threshold is not reached in this time, QLAND engages
The time after the airspeed threshold is reached over which the VTOL motor throttle goes to zero
The transition time when there is no airspeed sensor
The time a tiltrotor takes to tilt its motors from vertical to horizontal
questions.explain: The parameter description: "Transition time in milliseconds after minimum airspeed is reached". The timeout is the separate Q_TRANS_FAIL.

questions.q: In CRUISE with the throttle at zero the VTOL motors start every few seconds. What is the cause?
options: Q_ASSIST_SPEED is above AIRSPEED_MIN
Q_TRANS_DECEL is too low
Q_RTL_MODE = 0
Q_TRANSITION_MS is too long for this vehicle
questions.explain: CRUISE at zero throttle holds AIRSPEED_MIN; if that is below Q_ASSIST_SPEED, speed-based assistance starts immediately and cyclically.

questions.q: Speed 20 m/s, Q_TRANS_DECEL = 2 m/s². From what distance to the destination does the airbrake stage begin?
questions.explain: d = V²/(2·a) + 2V = 400/4 + 40 = 140 m: the stopping distance plus two seconds for motor spin-up.

questions.q: What does ArduPlane do on RC loss in QLOITER if bits 5 and 20 of Q_OPTIONS are not set?
options: RTL
QRTL
QLAND
It keeps hovering in QLOITER
questions.explain: events.cpp: in QSTABILIZE, QHOVER, QLOITER, QACRO, QAUTOTUNE it is QLAND; bit 5 gives QRTL, bit 20 gives RTL.

questions.q: The airspeed sensor is stuck at 3 m/s, Q_TRANS_FAIL = 0. What happens after you switch to FBWA at full throttle?
options: After 5 s the transition completes on Q_TRANSITION_MS
The firmware notices the mismatch with GPS at once and switches to synthetic airspeed
The transition does not complete and the VTOL motors run until the battery is empty
QLAND triggers after Q_ASSIST_DELAY
questions.explain: Without the airspeed threshold AIRSPEED_WAIT never ends, and without Q_TRANS_FAIL there is no timeout. ARSPD_WIND_MAX defaults to 0, so there is no mismatch check; even with it, in SITL the synthetic DCM airspeed after the sensor was disabled was biased low by the "learned" wind. With Q_TRANS_FAIL = 8, QLAND came after 8.0 s.

questions.q: Q_RTL_MODE = 1, RTL at 25 m/s, WP_LOITER_RAD = 60, RTL_RADIUS = 0, Q_TRANS_DECEL = 2. At what distance does RTL change to QRTL?
questions.explain: switch_QRTL(): when wp_distance < max(radius, d_stop); d_stop = 25²/4 = 156 m is greater than 60 m. In SITL at 25.2 m/s it was 158 m.

questions.q: What does the mission command DO_VTOL_TRANSITION with param1 = 3 do?
options: It switches the vehicle to QLAND
The following mission waypoints are flown in VTOL
It starts a forward transition from a hover
It enables the fixed-wing loiter approach
questions.explain: 3 is MAV_VTOL_STATE_MC: auto_state.vtol_mode = true. It works only in AUTO: "VTOL transition only in AUTO".

questions.q: QLOITER was selected from CRUISE at 28 m/s. What did the SITL 4.7.2 run show?
options: A stop in 91 m with an altitude gain of about 19 m, pitch up to 30°
Smooth braking at 2 m/s² per Q_TRANS_DECEL with no noticeable change in altitude
A stall and a loss of 20 m
The vehicle stayed in the fixed-wing mode down to AIRSPEED_MIN
questions.explain: The pitch grows to min(Q_A_ANGLE_MAX, PTCH_LIM_MAX_DEG), 30° in SITL, over the 3 s of Q_BACKTRANS_MS, while the wing keeps lifting at speed, hence the climb; Q_TRANS_DECEL sets only the planned deceleration of a mission and of QRTL.

questions.q: How does ArduPlane Q-assist differ from the PX4 quad-chute?
options: Q-assist switches off the forward motor
Q-assist starts the VTOL motors without a mode change
Q-assist triggers only on the back transition to a hover
Q-assist requires an external MAVLink command
questions.explain: A quad-chute is a forced transition to hover; Q-assist only adds VTOL motor thrust in the current fixed-wing mode.
